disposition: Scenario admission at lines 424-432 requires mutually exclusive fixture_predicate shapes for inject-mode-protocol-error-once and reject-mode, so their conjunction is rejected before this guard.

Recovery variation tests at tests/cursor-skill-eval.test.mjs:47-78 and 126-180 own fail-closed handling for missing or malformed argument proof and changed projections; an absent request produces the same no-recovery result.
validRecoveryContext at lines 709-720 requires contiguous ranges from zero through calls.length, so every iterated call index belongs to exactly one range.
All admitted request and response objects are JSON.parse outputs through parseFrame at line 213; JSON object values cannot carry a null prototype.
The only caller at line 161 invokes compactPending after Array.isArray(payload.pending), so its non-array fallback cannot execute.

The partial-handshake test at tests/cursor-skill-eval.test.mjs:764-796 proves that an invalid program path disables fixture injection and preserves the original request; an omitted final operand has the same observable result.
Backpressure tests at tests/cursor-skill-eval.test.mjs:655-683 and 994-1004 prove that accepted output drains before exit; whether the final callback finds queued waiters is scheduler-dependent.
The same backpressure tests own the wait-for-output contract; entering the promise arm depends on child-close versus stdout-callback scheduling.

The publication-failure test at tests/cursor-skill-eval.test.mjs:867-891 owns controlled child teardown without an unhandled error; later queued failure callbacks are idempotent re-entry into that same boundary.
SIGTERM, SIGKILL fallback and owner-loss tests at tests/cursor-skill-eval.test.mjs:1084-1114 own child termination; repeated stop requests are an idempotent teardown race.
Oversized-input tests at tests/cursor-skill-eval.test.mjs:961-979 own fail-closed input teardown; discarding later buffered stdin data is part of the same failure boundary.

The oversized-provider-frame and publication-failure tests at tests/cursor-skill-eval.test.mjs:867-891 and 981-992 own absence of partial output or evidence; late buffered stdout belongs to that teardown boundary.
Backpressure tests at tests/cursor-skill-eval.test.mjs:655-683 and 994-1004 own the output-drain promise; execution of its resolver callback is scheduler-dependent.
